title: When Does Prediction Pay in LPWAN Water-Quality Monitoring? Code and results
description: Code, configuration and result files for the paper 'When Does Prediction Pay in LPWAN Water-Quality Monitoring? Multi-Site Error-Bounded Report Suppression'. Trace-driven simulator of error-bounded dual-prediction schemes for multi-parameter water-quality nodes, baselines, the RLS-D predictor, a node-side CUSUM event detector, loss-recovery protocols, an NB-IoT/LoRaWAN energy model, and the scripts that regenerate every number, table and figure.
